name: Writing & delivery
manifestDescription: Revise and deliver the current document for WeChat, X or text
title: Writing & delivery
subtitle: Current document · Writing skills · Preview · Copy and export
howToOpen: Open from Apps, the status bar or the command palette. Edit the source in the main editor.

settings.title: Writing & delivery
settings.desc: The independent writing pack is bundled. Local typography requires no Python.
settings.enabledDesc: Controls launch entries. Source documents, legacy preferences and skills are retained.
settings.themeDesc: Local layout theme for WeChat and X Articles.

delivery.stale: The source changed. Generate a new preview.
delivery.copied: Copied. Check the pasted result on the target platform.
delivery.empty: Open a Markdown note or enter an existing article path. Legacy WeChat drafts work in place.
delivery.boundary: The source remains authoritative. Typography does not rewrite it. Image generation and PNG require available tools; publishing is a separate action.
delivery.unsaved: Save the source before generating or copying a delivery.
delivery.setupHint: Select an article and action, then start explicitly. Preview does not call AI.
delivery.reviewOnly: Give suggestions in chat; do not edit the source
delivery.editSource: Edit the selected article; preserve facts and author intent
delivery.taskScope: Target: {{path}}. Use attached references only; stop when the target or a required capability is missing.
delivery.start: Start AI task for this article
delivery.chooseAction: Select an action to see what it does. AI has not started.
delivery.agentBusy: AI is busy or loading. Stop or finish the current task first.

actionHelp.topmind-revise: Review the selected article while preserving facts and author intent.
actionHelp.topmind-format: Adjust text formatting only. Use Preview below for WeChat/X rich text without AI.
actionHelp.topmind-briefs: Prepare a brief from the selected article.
actionHelp.topmind-viral-posts: Prepare a social post from this article; do not publish.
actionHelp.topmind-wechat-post: Prepare a WeChat draft. Preview, copy and export below.
actionHelp.topmind-x-article: Prepare an X Article from the selected document; do not publish.
actionHelp.topmind-cover: No image-generation tool is connected. This prepares a cover prompt and composition only; vision is not image generation.
actionHelp.topmind-poster: No PNG renderer is connected. This prepares HTML/layout only.

delivery.allowWeb: Allow external fact checking and web research
